children: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) (NYSE:

) announced today that Josephine Vaccarello has been named President of MSG Entertainment. In this elevated role, Ms. Vaccarello, who most recently served as the Company’s Executive Vice President, Live, will oversee the strategy and operations of multiple areas of the business as MSG Entertainment continues to focus on enhancing and expanding its portfolio of live experiences for the millions of guests welcomed to the Company’s venues at hundreds of events each year.

Ms. Vaccarello’s purview now includes oversight of the Company’s entertainment and sports bookings across concerts, family shows, comedy, performing arts, special events, and all non-New York Knicks and New York Rangers sports bookings, as well as the productions business, which includes the Radio City Rockettes and the
Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes

. She will work closely with executive leadership to grow the business, including maximizing the event calendar and ticket sales and delivering unique experiences for artists and fans. In addition to her responsibilities at MSG Entertainment, Ms. Vaccarello will continue to oversee booking live concert residencies and touring acts at Sphere, which is owned by Sphere Entertainment Co. and is part of the MSG Family of Companies.

“Over her nearly thirty-year career with MSG, Josephine has not only been instrumental in growing our live event business but also established herself as one of the industry’s most impactful and respected leaders,” said Jim Dolan, Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of MSG Entertainment and Sphere Entertainment. “Her deep understanding of our businesses and unparalleled industry relationships will continue to be an asset in this new role as we execute on our strategic vision for the Company, including identifying innovative growth opportunities and furthering our leadership position in live experiences.”

“I am fortunate to have built my career at a company like MSG, which has always used the breadth of its portfolio to offer a wide range of events that push live entertainment forward and create unforgettable experiences for millions of fans each year,” said Ms. Vaccarello. “I am honored to take on this expanded role and look forward to continuing to work with teams across the MSG Family of Companies to deliver world-class live events that grow our businesses and keep our Company at the forefront of the industry.”

Ms. Vaccarello’s career with MSG Entertainment spans nearly 30 years in roles of increasing responsibility. She has been instrumental in creating new signature events, conceptualizing artist residencies, and delivering unique experiences for artists and fans at world-renowned performance venues: New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; The Chicago Theatre; and Sphere in Las Vegas. This includes some of the most impactful residencies in recent history including Billy Joel’s 150-show franchise run at The Garden; Harry Styles’ ongoing 30-show residency at The Garden; and bookings at Sphere since U2 opened the groundbreaking immersive venue in September 2023. She has also been a key leader in enhancing the artist and audience experience in MSG Entertainment’s venues, including through advanced audio technology such as Sphere Immersive Sound, which made its concert debut at the Beacon Theatre before being introduced at Sphere and then at Radio City Music Hall.
Under her leadership, the MSG Family of Companies’ venues have consistently ranked among the top venues in the world by industry-leading trade publications
Billboard
and
Pollstar.
According to
Billboard’s
2025 year-end venue rankings,

Sphere ranked as the highest grossing venue in the world, with Madison Square Garden ranking #3, while Radio City ranked #1 in its size category. The Beacon Theatre, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden and The Chicago Theatre also ranked in the top 10 highest grossing venues of their size in the U.S. Ms. Vaccarello has been recognized with numerous industry accolades, including in 2026 being named to
Billboard’s
“Power 100” and 2026 “Women in Music” executive lists, and
Pollstar’s
“Impact 50” and “Women of Live Hall of Fame”.
Ms. Vaccarello began her career with the Company in 1998 as an administrative assistant. She is a graduate of SUNY, Albany with a bachelor’s degree in communications.
About Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp.

Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually.
